d_and_a.source: us-gaap:Depreciation (depreciation of property and equipment only; amortization not separately captured), 10-K 0001652044-26-000018

revenue_growth.source: Assumption: FY2025 growth was 15.1% (402,836/350,018); FY2024 13.9%. Fade from 14% toward 7% as the base grows and AI/cloud growth matures.

ebit_margin.source: Assumption: held at FY2025 level of 32.0% (129,039/402,836); rising depreciation from heavy capex offsets operating leverage.

tax_rate.source: Assumption: approx. US federal 21% less typical foreign-derived income deductions and credits; FY2025 effective rate not directly pulled, so reviewer should verify against the 10-K.

da_pct_revenue.source: Assumption: FY2025 was 5.2% (21,136/402,836) but is rising quickly with the capex build (FY2023 3.9%, FY2024 4.4%); 8% reflects the growing depreciable base.

capex_pct_revenue.source: Assumption: FY2025 was 22.7% (91,447/402,836), FY2024 15.0%; fade to 18% as the AI infrastructure build normalizes.

wacc.source: Assumption via CAPM: risk-free 4.86% (US Treasury 10Y par, 2026-11-06) + beta ~1.05 (assumed, approx. large-cap tech) x ERP 4.46% (Damodaran US, 2026-02-16) = ~9.5% cost of equity; debt is ~1% of capital (total debt 48,543 vs equity), so WACC ~ cost of equity.

terminal_growth.source: Assumption: below the 4.86% risk-free rate and near long-run nominal US GDP growth.

net_debt.source: deskstack derived net_debt = total debt 48,543 - cash 30,708 - marketable securities 96,135, 10-K 0001652044-26-000018 (negative = net cash)
